findings.fix: Use `simp [← smul_tmul']` (or whatever minimal simp set works), matching the sibling lemma.
findings.issue: `tmulCLM_comp_adjoint` closes its goal with an eight-lemma `simp only [..., ← smul_tmul', Completion.coe_smul]` chain, while its mirror `flip_tmulCLM_comp_adjoint` just above closes the same kind of goal with `by simp`. The long named-lemma chain is brittle under renames.

summary: Proofs are generally robust and use no change/show/erw, but one private ℓ² reindexing proof is an opaque uncommented term chain, and two pieces of reasoning are copy-pasted instead of factored into lemmas.
